ai_summary: Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited (ABDL) has disclosed receiving an unsolicited ESG rating of '63', categorized as 'Adequate', from NSE Sustainability Ratings & Analytics. This independent assessment, derived from public disclosures and FY26 data, provides investors with a baseline understanding of ABDL's sustainability performance. The unsolicited nature means ABDL did not actively engage in this specific rating process, but there are no immediate red flags identified regarding the company's ESG standing or its disclosure practices.
